summary: Frontend-only Playwright verification of Batch Studio bottom-sheet redesign of the multi-select bulk action bar. All 12 requested scenarios executed successfully at 390x844 mobile viewport against the preview URL. Notes were seeded directly into localforage IndexedDB (IronRabbit -> notes store, out-of-line keys) and DB state was validated after every action.

test_results_per_scenario.1_lean_multiselect_pill: PASS - Pill shows '2 selected' + 'Batch Studio' gradient button (data-testid='multiselect-studio-btn') + Cancel X (data-testid='multiselect-cancel'). No inline bulk action icons remain on the pill.
test_results_per_scenario.2_batch_studio_sheet_opens: PASS - Clicking gradient button opens sheet (data-testid='batch-studio-sheet') with header 'Batch Studio' + '2 selected' count, description present, and red Delete Selected row visible at bottom.
test_results_per_scenario.3_grid_tiles_present: PASS - All 8 testids present: bs-move, bs-duplicate, bs-pin, bs-color, bs-alarm, bs-export-pdf, bs-delete, bs-cancel. bs-move label reads 'Move to Category' (smartBatchMode defaults to 'move').
test_results_per_scenario.4_bulk_pin_unpin: PASS - Selected 2 unpinned notes, bs-pin => sheet closes and both notes get pinned=true in IndexedDB. Undo (sonner toast) reverts both to pinned=false. Repeated on 2 already-pinned notes => bs-pin unpins them (pinned=false).
test_results_per_scenario.5_bulk_recolor: PASS - bs-color reveals inline swatch row (screenshot captured). Clicking bs-color-cyan closes sheet and sets color='cyan' on both selected notes. Undo restores color='purple' on both.
test_results_per_scenario.6_bulk_set_alarm: PASS - bs-alarm reveals inline date/time picker. Filling bs-alarm-date (tomorrow) + bs-alarm-time (09:00) + bs-alarm-apply sets alarm.enabled=true with correct ISO datetime on both notes.
test_results_per_scenario.7_bulk_clear_alarm: PASS - Two notes seeded with existing alarms. bs-alarm -> bs-alarm-clear sets alarm.enabled=false, datetime=null on both.
test_results_per_scenario.8_bulk_export_pdf: PASS - bs-export-pdf fires jsPDF download (filename 'Iron Rabbit-selected-YYYY-MM-DD.pdf'). Sheet closes, selection clears, success toast shown.
test_results_per_scenario.9_bulk_delete: PASS - bs-delete + confirm dialog deletes both selected notes from IndexedDB; unselected note (d3) is preserved.
test_results_per_scenario.10_bulk_duplicate_regression: PASS - bs-duplicate produces N new notes with ' (copy)' suffix in same category (verified: ['Uno','Uno (copy)','Dos','Dos (copy)']).
test_results_per_scenario.11_bulk_move_regression: PASS - bs-move closes Batch Studio sheet and opens MoveToCategoryModal (title 'Move 2 notes to...'). Handoff between the two modals is clean (Studio unmounts before Move modal mounts).
test_results_per_scenario.12_cancel_from_studio: PASS - bs-cancel closes sheet and MultiSelectBar remains visible. Pressing Escape also closes the sheet while preserving the selection.

critical_code_review_comments: MultiSelectBar/BatchStudio flow only works for icon-view NoteTile (data-testid='note-tile-<id>'). List/accordion view (data-testid='accordion-note-<id>') still cannot enter select mode - parity gap flagged in iteration 9 remains open.

NotesApp.jsx is now ~1652 lines. The new bulkTogglePin/bulkSetColor/bulkSetAlarm/bulkClearAlarm/bulkExportPDF handlers plus _snapshotSelected/_restore helpers are prime candidates to extract into a useBulkActions hook.

In bulkExportPDF (server.jsx L734-752) the PDF colour comes from NOTE_COLORS[note.color].accent - if a note has an unknown/legacy colour value the doc.setTextColor call falls back to '#000' via string, which jsPDF accepts, but a stricter type-safe fallback would be safer.

BatchStudioSheet applyAlarm() does not validate that the chosen datetime is in the future - user can silently set an alarm in the past. Consider disabling Apply Alarm when the resulting datetime <= now.

The Delete confirmation still uses window.confirm() in the bulk path - it is inconsistent with the rest of the app (which uses shadcn dialogs) and is unstyled on iOS. Consider a proper AlertDialog to match the design system.

bs-color: the inline swatches use plain <button> without data-testid='bs-color' for the currently-active tile ring state - the 'active' ring is visible only via the parent tile's ring-2 class, so automated regression on 'which colour is currently active' is difficult to assert. Minor observability nit.
seed_data_creation: Direct IndexedDB writes into IronRabbit -> notes store (out-of-line keys: store.put(note, note.id)). Each scenario re-seeds a fresh set of 2-3 notes in category 'TestBS' with predetermined IDs so exact selectors [data-testid='note-tile-<id>'] can be used.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL: https://color-task-timer.preview.emergentagent.com. Icon-view NoteTile renders TWO testids for each note: 'note-tile-<id>' (the main tile) AND 'note-tile-edit-<id>' (an inner edit button). Using selector [data-testid^='note-tile-'] will match BOTH and clicking the wrong one opens the Edit dialog. ALWAYS target the exact id: [data-testid='note-tile-<id>']. To reach Batch Studio: (1) click view-mode-icon, (2) click select-mode-toggle, (3) click note tiles by exact testid, (4) click multiselect-studio-btn. Sonner Undo toasts get intercepted by app-container subtree pointer events during Playwright's stability wait - use JS click via page.evaluate(() => document.querySelector('button:contains(Undo)').click()) or an equivalent JS-driven click to reliably trigger Undo. Data schema: note.pinned (bool), note.color (one of purple/cyan/lime/pink/orange), note.alarm = { enabled, datetime, sound, haptic }. All 12 Batch Studio scenarios verified end-to-end.
rca of the issue: N/A - all scenarios passed. Two test-tooling issues encountered during first run: (a) selector [data-testid^='note-tile-'] accidentally matched the nested 'note-tile-edit-<id>' edit button and clicked it, opening the Edit Note dialog whose overlay then blocked every subsequent click - fixed by using exact-id selectors; (b) Playwright ElementHandle clicks on Sonner toast Undo buttons intermittently reported 'subtree intercepts pointer events' because the toast unmounts/re-mounts during hover - fixed by invoking .click() via page.evaluate to bypass the actionability wait.
